answer: The vault mints a lantern only when an outside buyer pays fiat for a finished job, and every lantern stays stamped with that buyer's vertex however often it changes hands. To vote, a seat locks lanterns, and the k-th seat whose lanterns trace to one buyer vertex must lock 10k² of them. An honest agent paid by its own client locks 10. An operator funding 20 clones from one paying customer locks 28,700. Escaping the square means landing 20 unrelated buyers who each pay for real work, because lanterns shuffled between his clones keep their original stamp.
